decisions.decision: Review: No I2C pull-up resistors visible — OLED display (if I2C) requires 4.7kΩ pull-ups on SDA/SCL to 3.3V
decisions.rationale: Add two 4.7kΩ resistors from I2C SDA/SCL lines to 3.3V

decisions.decision: Review: Only one 5.1kΩ CC pull-down resistor (R1) but USB-C requires two — one on CC1 and one on CC2
decisions.rationale: Add a second 5.1kΩ resistor on the other CC line (CC1/CC2)

decisions.decision: Review: Missing timing components (R_A, R_B, C) for NE555 astable oscillation. Pins 7 (DISCH), 6 (THRES), 2 (TRIG) have no resistor or capacitor connected.
decisions.rationale: Add R_A between VCC and pin 7, R_B between pin 7 and pin 6/2, and C between pin 6/2 and GND. For ~1 Hz with near-50% duty, try R_A=1kΩ, R_B=470kΩ, C=1.5µF.

decisions.decision: Review: RESET pin (pin 4) is not connected. NE555 will not operate reliably with RESET floating.
decisions.rationale: Connect pin 4 to VCC (5V) to enable the timer.

decisions.decision: Review: LED anode (D201:1) tied to GND while cathode driven by OUT via R1. The LED will not light in this configuration.
decisions.rationale: Connect LED anode to OUT (pin 3) through R1, cathode to GND. Or connect anode to VCC and cathode to OUT through R1 for inverted drive.
